name: Create a contact
intent: Create a new contact (person) in the account, optionally assigning lists and attributes in the same call.
description:
Follow this format when passing a "SMS" phone number as an attribute. Accepted Number Formats 91xxxxxxxxxx +91xxxxxxxxxx 0091xxxxxxxxxx Creates new contacts on Brevo. Contacts can be created by passing either -

1. email address of the contact (email_id),
2. phone number of the contact (to be passed as "SMS" field in "attributes" along with proper country code), For example- {"SMS":"+91xxxxxxxxxx"} or {"SMS":"0091xxxxxxxxxx"}
3. ext_id
when_to_use: When a new person must be added to the CRM and you know at least their email (or SMS number).
when_not_to_use: Do not use to modify an existing contact — use contacts.update_contact. For a double opt-in flow use contacts.create_doi_contact.
preconditions: Valid API key with contacts write access
A unique email address that does not already exist in the account

attributes.description: Pass the set of attributes and their values. The attribute's parameter should be passed in capital letter while creating a contact. Values that don't match the attribute type (e.g. text or string in a date attribute) will be ignored. **These attributes must be present in your Brevo account**. For eg: **{"FNAME":"Elly", "LNAME":"Roger", "COUNTRIES": ["India","China"]}**

name: Create Contact via DOI (Double-Opt-In) Flow
intent: Create a contact through a double opt-in (DOI) flow, sending a confirmation email before the contact becomes active.
description: <Note title="How to use attributes param?">attributes param in this endpoint is an object containing key-value pairs where values can be either a string, integer, array, or boolean. You can create key-value pairs with these four datatypes. When a value is an array, it should be an array of strings.</Note>
when_to_use: When consent must be proven and the signup source requires DOI.
when_not_to_use: Do not use when explicit consent is already recorded — use contacts.create_contact.
preconditions: A DOI template must be configured
Valid list id

attributes.description: Pass the set of attributes and their values. **These attributes must be present in your Brevo account**. For eg. **{'FNAME':'Elly', 'LNAME':'Roger', 'COUNTRIES': ['India','China']}**

contactPixelTrackingConsent.description: Consent of the DOI recipient for open (pixel) and click tracking in the double opt-in confirmation email, resolved by the sender at send time. Considered only if the per-contact pixel tracking consent feature is enabled for your account. Pass `true` if this recipient has consented to open and click tracking, in which case the open pixel and tracked links identify the recipient. Pass `false` to anonymise the open and click events (counted in aggregate statistics only). If it is not passed, the recipient is treated as unknown consent status and the email is still sent (the open and click are anonymised unless your account tracks unknown-consent contacts). A value other than `true`/`false` is rejected. Ignored when the feature is not enabled for your account.

name: Delete a contact
intent: Permanently delete a contact by identifier.
description:
There are 2 ways to delete a contact

Option 1- https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts/{identifier}

Option 2- https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts/{identifier}?identifierType={}

Option 1 only works if identifierType is email_id (for EMAIL) or contact_id (for ID of the contact),where you can directly pass the value of EMAIL and ID of the contact.

Option 2 works for all identifierType, use email_id for EMAIL attribute, contact_id for ID of the contact, ext_id for EXT_ID attribute, phone_id for SMS attribute, whatsapp_id for WHATSAPP attribute, landline_number_id for …
when_to_use: When a person must be erased from the account (e.g. a validated GDPR erasure request).
when_not_to_use: Prefer blocklisting or unsubscribing when the goal is to stop sending emails but keep history.
preconditions: The contact must exist
Irreversible: contact history and stats are removed

name: Export contacts
intent: Request an asynchronous export of contacts (all or a filtered subset) to a file.
description: It returns the background process ID which on completion calls the notify URL that you have set in the input. File will be available in csv. When no contact matches the filter, no export process is created: the endpoint answers `200` with an empty object instead of `202` with a processId. A recurring export should treat that as "nothing to do" rather than as a failure, and must not assume a processId is always present.
when_to_use: When you need a portable copy of contact data for analysis or migration.
when_not_to_use: Do not poll aggressively — poll processes.get_process or wait for the webhook.
preconditions: Export scope (all contacts or a segment/filter) must be defined

customContactFilter.description: Set the filter for the contacts to be exported.

actionForContacts.description:
**Mandatory if neither actionForEmailCampaigns nor actionForSmsCampaigns is passed.** This will export the contacts on the basis of the provided action, restricted to the contacts selected by the other filters below. * **allContacts** - Fetch all the selected contacts. * **subscribed & unsubscribed** - Fetch the subscribed / unsubscribed (blacklisted via any means) contacts among the selected contacts. * **unsubscribedPerList** - Fetch the contacts that are unsubscribed from the given listId only; this action requires listId.

The selection must be narrowed by at least one of **listId**, **segmentId**, **modifiedSince** or **createdSince**. Any of them can be combined with the action, so for example `unsubscribed` together with `modifiedSince` exports the contacts that are currently blocklisted and were modified after the given date-time, with no list or segment involved.

actionForEmailCampaigns.description: **Mandatory if neither actionForContacts nor actionForSmsCampaigns is passed.** This will export the contacts on the basis of provided action applied on email campaigns. * **openers & nonOpeners** - emailCampaignId is mandatory. Fetch the list of readers / non-readers for a particular email campaign. * **clickers & nonClickers** - emailCampaignId is mandatory. Fetch the list of clickers / non-clickers for a particular email campaign. * **unsubscribed** - emailCampaignId is mandatory. Fetch the list of all unsubscribed (blacklisted via any means) contacts for a particular email campaign. * **hardBounces & softBounces** - emailCampaignId is optional. Fetch the list of hard bounces / soft bounces for a particular / all email campaign(s).

actionForSmsCampaigns.description: **Mandatory if neither actionForContacts nor actionForEmailCampaigns is passed.** This will export the contacts on the basis of provided action applied on sms campaigns. * **unsubscribed** - Fetch the list of all unsubscribed (blacklisted via any means) contacts for all / particular sms campaigns. * **hardBounces & softBounces** - Fetch the list of hard bounces / soft bounces for all / particular sms campaigns.

createdSince.description: Considered only if **actionForContacts** is passed, ignored otherwise. Exports only the contacts created after the given date-time. The value must be a full RFC 3339 date-time: a date-only value such as `2026-10-01` is rejected, and so is a value without a timezone, so pass either the `Z` suffix or an explicit `+HH:MM` offset.

emailCampaignId.description: Considered only if **actionForEmailCampaigns** is passed, ignored otherwise. **Mandatory if action is one of the following - openers, nonOpeners, clickers, nonClickers, unsubscribed.** The id of the email campaign for which the corresponding action shall be applied in the filter.

listId.description: ID of the list. Considered only if **actionForContacts** is passed. At least one of listId, segmentId, modifiedSince or createdSince must be provided; listId and segmentId cannot be used together.

modifiedSince.description: Considered only if **actionForContacts** is passed, ignored otherwise. Exports only the contacts modified after the given date-time. The value must be a full RFC 3339 date-time: a date-only value such as `2026-10-01` is rejected, and so is a value without a timezone, so pass either the `Z` suffix or an explicit `+HH:MM` offset. Note that a contact's modification date changes on any update, not only on a subscription change.

segmentId.description: ID of the segment. Considered only if **actionForContacts** is passed. At least one of listId, segmentId, modifiedSince or createdSince must be provided; listId and segmentId cannot be used together.

smsCampaignId.description: Considered only if **actionForSmsCampaigns** is passed, ignored otherwise. The id of sms campaign for which the corresponding action shall be applied in the filter.

disableNotification.description: To avoid generating the email notification upon contact export, pass **true**

name: Update contact attribute
description: Update an existing contact attribute identified by its category and name. For category-type attributes, you can update the enumeration values; for calculated or global attributes, update the computed value formula; and for normal multiple-choice attributes, update the multicategory options. None of the category or multicategory option values can exceed 200 characters.
preconditions: A valid Brevo API key authorized for this resource.
The resource identified by the path parameters must exist; otherwise the API returns 404.

enumeration.description: List of the values and labels that the attribute can take. **Use only if the attribute's category is "category"** None of the category options can exceed max 200 characters. For example, **[{"value":1, "label":"male"}, {"value":2, "label":"female"}]**

multiCategoryOptions.description: Use this option to add multiple-choice attributes options only if the attribute's category is "normal". **This option is specifically designed for updating multiple-choice attributes. None of the multicategory options can exceed max 200 characters.**. For example: **["USA","INDIA"]**

value.description: Value of the attribute to update. **Use only if the attribute's category is 'calculated' or 'global'**

name: Update multiple contacts
description: Update multiple contacts in a single API call by passing an array of contact objects. Each contact in the array must be identified by one of: email, id, or sms (only one identifier per contact). You can update attributes, blacklist status, list memberships, ext_id, and transactional email forbidden senders for each contact in the batch.
preconditions: A valid Brevo API key authorized for this resource.

contacts.description: List of contacts to be updated

attributes.description: Pass the set of attributes to be updated. **These attributes must be present in your account**. To update existing email address of a contact with the new one please pass EMAIL in attribtes. For example, **{ "EMAIL":"newemail@domain.com", "FNAME":"Ellie", "LNAME":"Roger"}**. Keep in mind transactional attributes can be updated the same way as normal attributes. Mobile Number in **SMS** field should be passed with proper country code. For example: **{"SMS":"+91xxxxxxxxxx"} or {"SMS":"0091xxxxxxxxxx"}**

email.description: Email address of the user to be updated (For each operation only pass one of the supported contact identifiers. Email, id or sms)

emailBlacklisted.description: Set/unset this field to blacklist/allow the contact for emails (emailBlacklisted = true)

ext_id.description: Pass your own Id to update ext_id of a contact.

id.description: id of the user to be updated (For each operation only pass one of the supported contact identifiers. Email, id or sms)

listIds.description: Ids of the lists to add the contact to

items.description: Id of the list to add the contact to

sms.description: SMS of the user to be updated (For each operation only pass one of the supported contact identifiers. Email, id or sms)

smsBlacklisted.description: Set/unset this field to blacklist/allow the contact for SMS (smsBlacklisted = true)

smtpBlacklistSender.description: transactional email forbidden sender for contact. Use only for email Contact

name: Update a consent group
description: Updates name, description, or signupMode of a consent group. At least one field must be provided. <Note>This endpoint is only available when the Consent Groups feature is enabled for your account.</Note>
preconditions: A valid Brevo API key authorized for this resource.
The resource identified by the path parameters must exist; otherwise the API returns 404.

id.description: ID of the consent group to update

name.description: New name for the consent group (max 255 characters)

schema.description: Request body for updating a consent group. At least one field must be provided.

name.description: New name for the consent group (max 255 characters)

schema.description: A consent group representing a category of contact opt-in/opt-out preferences.

id.description: Unique identifier for the consent group

name.description: Display name of the consent group

description.description: Optional description of the consent group
description.example: Consent group for EU newsletter subscribers

signupMode.description: Controls how contacts are added to the group. `manual` — contacts are added explicitly via the API. `automatic` — contacts are added automatically at signup.

contactsCount.description: Number of contacts currently in this consent group

isDefault.description: Whether this is a system-created default consent group

createdAt.description: UTC date-time when the consent group was created (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)

updatedAt.description: UTC date-time when the consent group was last updated (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)

errors.meaning: Bad request. Possible error codes: `INVALID_ID` (id must be a positive integer), `NO_FIELDS_TO_UPDATE` (no fields provided in request body), `INVALID_SIGNUP_MODE` (invalid signupMode value), `FIELD_TOO_LONG` (name exceeds 255 or description exceeds 500 characters).
Consent Groups feature not enabled for this account. Error code: `CONSENT_GROUP_NOT_ENABLED`.
Consent group not found. Error code: `CONSENT_GROUP_NOT_FOUND`.
A consent group with this name already exists. Error code: `NAME_ALREADY_EXISTS`.

name: Update a contact
intent: Update an existing contact's attributes or list membership, identified by email, id, SMS number or ext_id.
description:
Follow this format when passing a "SMS" phone number as an attribute. Accepted Number Formats 91xxxxxxxxxx +91xxxxxxxxxx 0091xxxxxxxxxx There are 2 ways to update a contact

Option 1- https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts/{identifier}

Option 2- https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts/{identifier}?identifierType={}

Option 1 only works if identifierType is email_id (for EMAIL) or contact_id (for ID of the contact),where you can directly pass the value of EMAIL and ID of the contact.

Option 2 works for all identifierType, use email_id for EMAIL attribute, c…
when_to_use: When the person already exists and you need to change their data or list membership.
when_not_to_use: Do not use for bulk changes — use contacts.update_batch_contacts.
preconditions: The contact must exist; otherwise the API returns 404

identifier.description: Email (urlencoded) OR ID of the contact OR EXT_ID attribute (urlencoded) OR its SMS attribute value OR its WHATSAPP attribute value OR its LANDLINE_NUMBER attribute value

identifierType.description: email_id for Email, contact_id for ID of the contact, ext_id for EXT_ID attribute, phone_id for SMS attribute, whatsapp_id for WHATSAPP attribute, landline_number_id for LANDLINE_NUMBER attribute

To update existing email address of a contact with the new one please pass EMAIL in attributes. For example, **{ "EMAIL":"newemail@domain.com", "FNAME":"Ellie", "LNAME":"Roger", "COUNTRIES":["India","China"]}**. The attribute's parameter should be passed in capital letter while updating a contact. Values that don't match the attribute type (e.g. text or string in a date attribute) will be ignored .Keep in mind transactional attributes can be updated the same way as normal attributes. Mobile Number in **SMS** field should be passed with proper country code. For example: **{"SMS":"+91xxxxxxxxxx"} or {"SMS":"0091xxxxxxxxxx"}**
